beats.event: Sailor Dantès returns to Marseille and is to be made captain of the Pharaon
Engaged to Mercédès; the wedding feast begins
Danglars and Fernand write an anonymous denunciation of Dantès as a Bonapartist
Dantès is arrested at his own wedding table
Villefort burns the letter and locks him for life in the Château d'If
Fourteen years of solitary; near suicide from despair
Abbé Faria digs into his cell; educates him for eight years
Dying Faria reveals a vast treasure hidden on the isle of Monte Cristo
Dantès swaps himself for Faria's corpse; is flung into the sea and escapes
He digs up the Spada treasure on Monte Cristo; buys the title of Count
As the mysterious Count he enters Paris society through young Albert de Morcerf
Meets Mercédès after twenty-three years; she recognizes him but keeps silent
Exposes Fernand's betrayal of Ali Pasha; Fernand shoots himself in disgrace
Manipulates the Villefort household; Villefort goes mad discovering his wife's poisonings
Danglars is stripped of his fortune by bandits and reduced to beggary
Sickened by the collateral suffering, Dantès forgives Danglars and stops
The Count sails away with Haydée, leaving 'Wait and Hope' behind him
